data.description:
## Context
The planner must be compared with legacy decisions before it gains authority. Preview consumers require the existing mutation array and canonical hash to remain stable while lifecycle intent data is additive and versioned.

## Outcome
Run `TicketPlan` generation in shadow, compare its mutations/dispositions with legacy output, and add a versioned lifecycle-intents preview section that old consumers can ignore.

## Plan
1. Feed the same frozen observation to legacy differ and shadow planner. Fail tests on unexplained mutation or disposition divergence and name approved deltas.
2. Extend preview/manifest rendering with an additive versioned lifecycle-intents section. Preserve the existing mutation array bytes and canonical hash.
3. Ensure construction, check, dry-run, and shadow modes perform zero repository saves, ticket writes, Jira calls, or subprocess launches.
4. Add golden fixtures covering normal, deferred dependency, filtered, tombstoned, and partial-snapshot plans.

## Testing
Golden and poison tests pin old fields/hashes, the additive section, parity diagnostics, and zero I/O.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Shadow mutations and dispositions match legacy behavior for the ticket-sourced corpus except explicitly named approved deltas.
- [ ] Preview preserves the existing mutation array bytes and canonical hash.
- [ ] Preview adds one versioned lifecycle-intents section that legacy consumers may ignore.
- [ ] Construction, check, dry-run, and shadow paths perform zero repository/provider/subprocess writes.
- [ ] Parity failure identifies the ticket, observation version, and differing plan fields without unbounded or secret content.

## Out of scope
Production coordinator authority remains RP-03 S3.
data.title: RP-03 S2 T3 — Shadow plans through additive preview output
